title: Reject malformed text.normalize Skill payloads
goal: Ensure the built-in text.normalize Skill rejects undeclared input and output fields instead of treating malformed payloads as valid execution results.
context: Issue #347 requires installed Skills to execute and verify only through explicit contracts. The built-in normalization executor currently reads text while tolerating extra keys, and its verifier can accept output with undeclared fields.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass Skill policy, executor resolution, cancellation, or verification.
Do not enable new capabilities or alter workspace behavior.
Do not change unrelated provider, UI, or app project files.
acceptance_criteria: text.normalize rejects input objects containing fields beyond text.
text.normalize verification rejects output objects containing fields beyond text.
Regression tests prove malformed payloads fail closed.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If a regression test or required gate fails, inspect the failure, make the smallest in-scope correction, and rerun all required gates before merge.
